title: Demo mode
intro: Demo mode switches this McHarbor onto a separate database filled with a simulated estate, so every page can be explored with realistic data. Everything in it is fake, and nothing real is touched.
errorTitle: Could not load the demo mode status

state.label: Status
state.dataPresent: Present, kept for the next visit
state.clusteredBody: Demo mode restarts McHarbor onto a different database, which would split the cluster.

estate.liveTitle: What the demo estate contains right now

config.intro: Sizes of the simulated estate. Changing them rebuilds the demo data.
config.historyHelp: Days of history the demo contains: audit log, workflow runs, schedule runs, alerts and incidents.

error.range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
error.swarmNodes: Swarm needs at least one node per cluster: enter {{min}} or more.

notes.realData: Your real data is never modified. Leaving demo mode restarts McHarbor back onto it exactly as it was.
notes.restart: Entering, leaving and resetting demo mode restart McHarbor, so everyone signed in is briefly disconnected.
notes.disabled: Actions that would touch real systems are disabled in demo mode: McHarbor's own host services and host updates, self-update, instance backups, database migration, licence, storage locations, TLS, time zone and backup key settings, and plugin install and uninstall.

confirm.enterDescription: McHarbor restarts onto a separate database filled with a simulated estate of the sizes below. Demo data kept from an earlier visit is reused when the sizes are unchanged; changing them rebuilds the demo data. Your real data is not touched. Everyone signed in is briefly disconnected.
confirm.exitDescription: McHarbor restarts back onto your real data. The demo data is kept, so the next visit continues where this one ended. Everyone signed in is briefly disconnected.
confirm.resetDescription: The demo database is deleted, and the next visit starts from a freshly generated estate. Your real data is not affected.
confirm.resetActiveDescription: Everything changed in demo mode is thrown away and McHarbor restarts onto a freshly generated estate. Your real data is not affected. Everyone signed in is briefly disconnected.
confirm.applySizesDescription: The demo is rebuilt with the sizes below: everything changed in demo mode is thrown away and McHarbor restarts onto the new estate. Your real data is not affected. Everyone signed in is briefly disconnected.

toast.enterSuccess: Entering demo mode. McHarbor is restarting.
toast.exitSuccess: Leaving demo mode. McHarbor is restarting.
toast.resetRestart: Demo data reset. McHarbor is restarting onto a fresh estate.
toast.restartRequired: McHarbor could not restart itself. Restart it manually to apply the change.

reason.clustered: Demo mode is unavailable on a clustered instance.
reason.busy: Another demo mode change is already in progress. Try again in a moment.

banner.title: Demo mode
